source: AAA gasprices.aaa.com national average, May 21 2026 ($4.56, +3¢ over last week). Memorial Day weekend pump prices hit a four-year high, closing in on the 2022 Memorial Day national average of $4.61 — surpassing that would mark a new all-time Memorial Day record. Per AAA: +52.5% above $2.99 Feb 28 baseline; ~$1.38/gal above year-ago levels. California highest at $6.14; Washington $5.78; Hawaii $5.64; Mississippi lowest at $4.01, Georgia $4.03. LendingTree: nationwide gas prices up 43.6% YoY, with Ohio +57.2%, New Hampshire +56%, Michigan +53.8% among the biggest 12-month state jumps on record. Trump 05-11 federal gas-tax suspension (18.4¢) still in legislative pipeline; no enactment through 05-21.
